claims.author: stickies-v
claims.harm: maintaining two parallel active logging RPC methods adds interface redundancy and maintenance burden
claims.quote: I don't think we should have 2 parallel active logging RPC methods, so imo this PR should mark logging deprecated

claims.author: stickies-v
claims.quote: The PR description should probably reference #34038 as an alternativate?

claims.author: stickies-v
claims.quote: I think this RPC would be easier to use and reason about if we split it into a read and a write method, where the write method makes a single change per call
claims.request: split the loglevel RPC into separate getlogconfig (read) and setloglevel (single-change write) methods

claims.author: stickies-v
claims.quote: At startup, I think it makes sense for `-loglevel` to be declarative (unlike the RPC, which is imperative).
claims.request: make -loglevel declarative at startup so category:level always overrides a global level regardless of order or source
